_comment: Single source of truth for token-estimate assumptions shared by the frontend, data scripts and plan generator. Rationale and OSINT evidence: docs/TOKEN_ESTIMATE_VALIDATION.md.

agentTask._comment: OSINT band for one autonomous agent task: conservative = floor of the 200-800K input + 30-100K output band; midpoint = band center; optimistic = ceiling. Interactive CLI sessions measure 60-240K. See docs/TOKEN_ESTIMATE_VALIDATION.md.

timeOfDayBlend._comment: Time-of-day volume blend for providers with off-peak discounts (e.g. DeepSeek, Z.ai). Default 80% off-peak, 20% peak.
